description: Creates a GDScript file, or adds functions, variables and signals to one. Every declaration written carries a type. Both load what they wrote under the project's own warning settings and answer with parses; the engine's reasons for a refusal come back under engine_messages. create answers with the extends and class_name the engine read, and a script declaring a class_name is put in the project's class list, with registered saying whether it is there. modify makes every addition or none, and answers with the line each one is on in the file written. Operations: create: a new script file; modify (needs modifications): add to an existing script.

className.description: create: a class_name for the script. Not with content.

content.description: create: the whole file, written as given, instead of a template, className and extends.

extends.description: create: the base class. Default Node. Not with content.

defaultValue.description: Variables: the initial value, as written in GDScript.

exportHint.description: Variables: the export hint, such as "range(0, 100)".

params.description: Functions and signals: the parameter list, "delta: float".

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scriptPath.description: Script file inside the project, such as "scripts/player.gd".

name: script_edit
